theme.theme_description: Dark luxury base (#0b0d14 / #121520) with high-value accents in royal violet (#7c3aed), electric cyan/blue (#0098f2), and warm champagne gold (#d4af37). The right-side A4 document preview remains authentic accounting style with a clean crisp white background (#ffffff), subtle elevation shadow, and crisp dark typography for official printing clarity.

layout_and_structure.responsive_split_screen: 2-column layout on desktop (50% dynamic input form / 50% live A4 invoice preview sticky), stacked single column on mobile with seamless tab/scroll toggles.
layout_and_structure.left_panel: Form panel with styled collapsible sections (Émetteur, Client, Détails Invoice, Line Items, Taxes & Remises, Payment & Footer Info). Fully interactive with immediate reactivity.
layout_and_structure.right_panel: Live dynamic A4 paper simulator (aspect ratio ~ 1 : 1.414, padding 32px to 40px) with dark canvas background to highlight the paper elevation shadow. Includes high-visibility top action bar (Download PDF, Print, Currency Switcher, Language Switcher, Clear Cache/Reset).
layout_and_structure.multi_language_rtl: Full trilingual support: French (FR), English (EN), and Arabic (AR). RTL layout direction auto-applied when AR is selected (`dir='rtl'` on html/container, swapping text alignments and icon placements).

key_features_and_controls.logo_management: Drag-and-drop Base64 image file uploader with instant thumbnail preview and clear/replace option.
key_features_and_controls.item_table: Dynamic row insertion and deletion, automated calculations (Qty * Price HT), global discount (% or flat rate), TVA tax %, Subtotal HT, Total Tax, Total Discount, and prominent Total TTC Net to Pay.

actions.pdf_export: Instant browser download via html2pdf.js targeting the clean A4 DOM element.
actions.print_mode: Native print triggers `@media print` CSS rules hiding sidebar, backgrounds, buttons, and forcing exact white background and full-width print fitting.
actions.new_invoice: Resets invoice number (or increments), client fields, and item list while preserving business emitter profile.
actions.reset_profile: Completely clears LocalStorage cache and restores fresh default demo profile.

testing_requirements.mandatory_rule: All interactive buttons, input fields, selects, tabs, dropdowns, and live preview calculated totals MUST have explicit kebab-case `data-testid` attributes.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.component_usage: Use installed Shadcn primitives (Card, Input, Select, Button, Dialog, Switch, Tooltip, Sonner toasts) with dark-mode tailored classes. No raw standard select dropdowns.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.interactive_states: Every button has active/hover glows with subtle border highlights in violet (#7c3aed), electric blue (#0098f2), or gold (#d4af37). Focus rings must be sharp and visible.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.toast_notifications: Use `sonner` for toast alerts when PDF is generated, invoice reset, or cache cleared.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.print_css: @media print rules must strip app headers, controls, shadows, dark backgrounds, and ensure the A4 invoice is perfectly framed with pure white background and clear dark text.
